Faculty Of Information Technologies NSU
The Faculty of Information Technologies at Novosibirsk State University (NSU) provides high-level training in computer science, mathematics, and physics for research and applied work.<SEP>The Faculty of Information Technologies at Novosibirsk State University (NSU) offers various academic programs including Bachelor's, Master's, and Postgraduate studies.

Computer Science And System Design
A bachelor's degree program focusing on programming tools and information system synthesis, combining Russian fundamental education with a British-style spiral curriculum.

Software Engineering And Computer Science
A bachelor's degree program training software developers and architects in AI, machine learning, computer vision, big data, bioinformatics, and blockchain.<SEP>A specialization within the Bachelor's program focusing on software development and computer science.

Discrete Analysis And Operations Research
This field encompasses discrete optimization, graph theory, coding theory, and cryptographic protocols.
